Class ScriptSimulation.Script

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.ScriptSimulation.Script
Enclosing class:
ScriptSimulation
public static final class ScriptSimulation.Script extends Object
The script of a model: the description, the interpreter and a thread for the calls of the user interface.
